admin-user-credentials.evidence: cmd_deploy starts Gotify with GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS=admin creating deterministic admin/admin credentials; cmd_seed and cmd_verify both authenticate with Basic auth admin:admin.

seeded-apps-checkout-api-and-warehouse-s.evidence: cmd_seed APPS list creates applications named Checkout API and Warehouse Scanner via POST /application along with Billing Worker, Security Alerts, and Release Monitor; cmd_verify EXPECTED_APPS includes Checkout API and Warehouse Scanner.
